# czc-v2026.10.23.3 (0.2.17.26)

Non-streaming `/v1/responses` requests that are served over the OpenAI
Responses WebSocket upstream return the model's answer again. Before this
release they could come back as `"status":"completed","output":[]` with no
text, although the upstream had generated (and billed) the answer. The GPT-6
channel monitor failed every check with
`challenge mismatch (expected N, got "")` because of this.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.23.2

### WS v2 forwarder rebuilds an empty terminal output

- The ChatGPT Codex WebSocket upstream now sends `response.completed` with
  `output: []`. The answer only arrives in `response.output_text.delta` and
  `response.output_item.done` events. Captured from production on
  2026-10-23 with `gpt-6-astra`: every sample had an empty terminal output,
  one `output_item.done` message item, and `usage.output_tokens=5`.
- `forwardOpenAIWSV2` returned the terminal `response` object as is to
  non-streaming callers, so they received an empty output. The HTTP
  SSE-to-JSON path already rebuilt the output from those events; the WS path
  did not.
- The WS v2 forwarder now records each upstream event and repairs the
  terminal event before writing it to the client. It uses the raw
  `output_item.done` items first (item id, `phase` and unknown item types are
  kept), then text and function-call deltas, then image generation results.
  A terminal output that is already complete is not changed.
- The fix covers both modes:
  - Non-streaming: the JSON response contains the answer again.
  - Streaming: the final `response.completed` event now carries `output` too,
    same as the HTTP SSE path. Delta events are forwarded unchanged.
- The repair logic of the HTTP SSE stream path was moved into a shared
  `responsesTerminalOutputCollector`. The HTTP path calls it in the same
  order as before.

### Impact seen in production

- GPT-6 channel monitor (`gpt-6-astra`, group GPT-PRO, `api_mode=responses`):
  808 `challenge mismatch ... got ""` failures between 2026-10-22 10:00 UTC
  and this release. The `upstream HTTP 502: Our servers are currently
  overloaded` results in the same period come from OpenAI and are not
  addressed here.
- Any client that sends `stream:false` to `/v1/responses` and is routed to
  an OpenAI OAuth account over WS v2 was affected the same way. In the last
  24 hours before this release, 12,281 `/v1/responses` requests from 79 API
  keys went through that transport. The usage log does not record whether
  the client asked for streaming, so how many of these got an empty output
  is not known. Streaming clients that read the deltas (Codex CLI) were not
  affected.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.26`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in. No database migration and no configuration change.

## Compatibility

- Billing is unchanged. Token usage, image counts and the WS session delta
  chain are still taken from the unmodified upstream events, so items added
  to the terminal output are not counted twice.
- Responses whose terminal output already lists all items are returned
  byte-for-byte as before.

## Verification

Passed:

- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./internal/service`, `gofmt` on the changed
  files.
- `go test -count=1 ./...` on `dev-czc` and again on `main-czc`: 52/52 packages with tests
  pass.
  `internal/service` failed once on
  `TestOllamaCloudUsageRefreshSingleflightAndRunnerDeduplicateSharedGroup`
  (a known timing-sensitive test in unrelated Ollama code). It passed 8/8
  when run alone, and the whole package passed when rerun.
- New tests in `openai_ws_forwarder_v2_terminal_output_test.go`, built from
  the captured production events: non-stream rebuild from
  `output_item.done`; stream rebuild of `response.completed`; non-stream
  rebuild from deltas only; a complete terminal output stays untouched; an
  empty turn stays `output: []`. With the WS v2 change reverted, the three
  rebuild tests fail.
- Before writing the fix, six live `gpt-6-astra` event streams were
  replayed through the release code: 6/6 empty without the repair, 6/6
  correct answers with it, checked with the channel monitor's own text
  extraction and challenge validation.

Failed or skipped:

- `gofmt -l internal/service` lists 6 files that this release does not
  touch.
- golangci-lint is not installed locally; not run.
- Frontend tests and integration/e2e tests were not run; frontend source is
  unchanged and was rebuilt only for the embed build.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.23.2`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.23.3-<UTC timestamp>` created during
this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. Rolling back brings back empty
non-streaming WS v2 responses and the GPT-6 monitor failures.
